title: Rydberg atoms for electric field gradiometry
authors: Philip Kitson, Wayne J. Chetcuti, Gerhard Birkl, Luigi Amico, and Juan Polo

Author(s): Philip Kitson, Wayne J. Chetcuti, Gerhard Birkl, Luigi Amico, and Juan Polo

We propose a quantum sensor for electric fields based on networks of Rydberg atoms. The sensing mechanism exploits the strong dependence of the Rydberg blockade on the applied electric field near a Förster resonance.
